title: Finance Assistant
description:
- Interim Finance Assistant role in Birmingham, minimum 6 months, supporting a bus
- Broad, all round transactional exposure: month end journals, prepayments, accrua
- Circa £30,000 to £40,000, part qualified level ideal but experience is the prior

Finance Assistant
Location: Birmingham
Contract: Interim, initial minimum 6 months
Day Rate: £180 - £200 per day

About the role
A well established and growing business based in Birmingham is centralising its finance function as part of a wider restructure, bringing month end work in from regional offices into one central team. As part of this, they are looking for a Finance Assistant to join on an interim basis and support the transition, taking on a broad range of transactional and month end tasks as the team scales up.

This is a great opportunity for a finance assistant with solid all round transactional experience to get involved early in a centralisation project, working closely with the finance manager and gaining exposure to a business handling multiple entities and regional teams.

Key responsibilities
- Posting month end journals
- Preparing prepayments and accruals
- Bank reconciliations and cash book postings
- Supporting the month end close process as regional businesses transition in
- General all round transactional finance support

What we are looking for
- Solid, all round transactional finance experience, ideally including month end exposure
- Experience is the priority; part qualified level would be ideal but is not essential
- Background from a medium sized organisation with broad, all round exposure, rather than a very small business or a large corporate where duties were limited to one narrow area
- SAGE or similar systems experience (such as NetSuite) is desirable but not essential
- Experience within a professional services environment would be an advantage

Why apply
You will be joining a business at an exciting point in its growth, with the chance to shape ways of working as the finance function centralises. There is scope for the role to be extended and, for the right person, potential for it to evolve further as the team develops.

Get in touch If this Finance Assistant role in Birmingham sounds like a good fit for your experience, we would love to hear from you. Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation.

title: Account Administrator
description:
We are proud to be recruiting on behalf of a thriving, growing, and dynamic organisation that is looking for a talented and motivated Account Administrator to join their team. This is a company that is genuinely going places - and they want the right person to grow with them.

If you are someone who takes pride in keeping things running smoothly, enjoys being the backbone of a busy team, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

What You Will Be Doing
- Providing comprehensive administrative support across the business
- Managing diaries, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments
- Handling correspondence - emails, letters, and phone calls - in a professional and timely manner
- Maintaining accurate records, filing systems, and databases
- Preparing documents, reports, and presentations as required
- Supporting various departments with day-to-day administrative tasks
- Acting as a first point of contact for internal and external queries

What We Are Looking For
- Previous experience in an administrative or office support role
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Proficient in Microsoft Office - Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
- A positive, can-do attitude with a high level of attention to detail
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
- Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information

What Is On Offer
- A role within a genuinely thriving and ambitious organisation with real momentum
- Fantastic opportunities to develop your career and take on greater responsibility as the business grows
- Supportive, energetic team culture where hard work is recognised and rewarded
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays

This role is exclusively available through Consula.

To be considered, you must apply via Consula. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be accepted.

title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator

Location: Harborne, Birmingham

Basic Salary: £26,000 + Bonuses

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5:30pm

We're working with a growing independent estate agency looking for a Marketing & Client Services Coordinator to join their team.

This is a varied and exciting role combining property marketing, social media, content creation and client service.

The Role

You'll be involved in a wide range of activities, including:
- Preparing new properties for market, including property descriptions and floorplans
- Planning and creating social media content
- Writing blogs and local property content
- Coordinating direct-mail marketing campaigns
- Creating and repurposing video and property content
- Handling new enquiries and supporting existing clients
- Booking appointments and coordinating communication
- Bringing new ideas to improve the company's marketing and processes
- Managing multiple tasks, projects and deadlines

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Organized and highly detail-focused
- Confident communicating with people
- Creative with a good eye for engaging content
- Comfortable using technology and learning new systems
- Able to manage multiple priorities
- Proactive and full of ideas
- Keen to learn, develop and take ownership

Estate agency experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Full training will be provided on the property software, CRM, floorplans and internal processes.

Why Join?

This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious independent estate agency where you'll have the chance to make the role your own.

As the business grows, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and develop your career across marketing, client services and property.

The role is initially being recruited due to a maternity leave opening, with the potential for the right person to build a long-term career within the business.

Interested?

If you're organized, creative, confident and looking for a role where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: People & Recruitment Coordinator
company: ADI Group Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
People & Recruitment Coordinator

Location: Kings Norton, Birmingham

About the Role

We're looking for a People & Recruitment Coordinator to join our Group HR team and support both recruitment and day-to-day HR administration across adi Group.

Around 40-50% of the role will focus on recruitment, including sourcing candidates, screening applications, carrying out initial telephone calls, coordinating interviews, managing candidate communication and maintaining recruitment systems and pipelines.

You'll work closely with our People & Talent Advisor, supporting recruitment across a range of specialist and technical roles.

The rest of the role will focus on practical HR administration, including new starters, onboarding, induction, HR systems, employee records, benefits, training, employee changes, leavers and general HR support.

This role would suit someone who enjoys a varied, hands-on coordination role, likes keeping processes organised and accurate, and is happy supporting a busy HR team.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activity across the Group, from vacancy advertising through to interview coordination and candidate management.
- Proactively source candidates using LinkedIn, job boards and recruitment databases.
- Review CVs and applications and carry out initial screening calls.
- Maintain candidate pipelines and recruitment records.
- Coordinate interviews and maintain regular communication with candidates and hiring managers.
- Support with recruitment reporting and system administration.
- Prepare offer letters, contracts and new starter documentation.
- Support onboarding and induction activity.
- Set up new starters on HR systems and relevant platforms.
- Support with Human Focus, Drive IQ and other employee system administration.
- Maintain accurate employee records and documentation.
- Support with employee changes and standard HR administration.
- Support with benefits portal administration.
- Support with leaver and offboarding administration.
- Support apprenticeship recruitment and Apprenticeship Academy activity.
- Support the Responsible Business programme and associated activity.
- Assist the People & Talent Advisor and Group HR Director with people projects and process improvements.
- Provide a professional, responsive and confidential service to candidates, employees and managers.

About You

We would like to hear from you if you have:
- Some previous experience in recruitment, HR administration or a people-focused role.
- A good understanding of the recruitment process.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail.
- Confidence dealing with candidates, employees and managers.
- Good communication and people skills.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, recruitment platforms and HR systems.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- A professional approach to confidential information.
- A reliable, consistent and methodical approach to work.
- An interest in a varied coordination role with a strong mix of recruitment and HR administration.

The Benefits
- The adi Pit Stop - savings and discounts portal with Reward Gateway

- Enhanced Employee Assistance Programme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Employee referral bonus of £500 for every successful new employee

- Annual employee awards
- Long service awards
- Free workwear

title: Events Coordinator
description:
EVENTS COORDINATOR
We are recruiting for an Events Coordinator to support the delivery of high-volume investor and corporate roadshows within a fast-paced, trading floor environment. This role involves full logistical coordination, including travel, accommodation, venues, and catering, while managing complex schedules and high email volumes.
The ideal candidate will bring strong administrative experience within a corporate or financial services setting, with excellent organisational skills, professionalism, and the confidence to liaise with senior stakeholders in a dynamic, five-day office-based role.

EVENTS COORDINATOR ROLE:
- Managing all logistics relating to non-deal roadshows
- Ensuring scheduling system information remains current and accurate
- Managing last-minute and late changes and keeping all parties informed at all times
- Updating internal systems post-event with final attendee details
- Coordinating in-person roadshow logistics, including flight recommendations, hotel bookings, ground transfers, AV requirements, visas, and catering
- Preparing investor profiles and printing presentation materials
- Reconciling expenses following completion of each roadshow
- Coordinating virtual roadshows by ensuring calendar accuracy across investor and corporate diaries and managing virtual meeting connections
- Remaining flexible to travel to London during peak periods and on an ad-hoc basis throughout the year

EVENTS COORDINATOR ESSENTIALS:
- Bringing experience as an Administrative Assistant within a financial services or corporate environment
- Demonstrating strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritise effectively, and follow up on open items
- Maintaining a high level of attention to detail across all tasks
- Working collaboratively with excellent interpersonal skills and a strong team-oriented approach across local and global assistant teams
- Communicating clearly, concisely, and confidently in all interactions
- Taking a proactive approach by using initiative, following up without prompting, and seeking clarification when needed
- Applying good judgement as an independent and resourceful thinker
- Remaining calm under pressure and managing multiple tasks efficiently in a busy environment
- Using MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Zoom proficiently

If you feel that you fit the above criteria, then please apply today by submitting your CV to us. title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable Clerk to join an established finance team on a temporary-to-permanent basis.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced candidate looking to develop their career within the automotive/manufacturing sector, with the potential to secure a permanent position following a successful temporary period.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience across Purchase Ledger and/or Sales Ledger, with a good understanding of invoice processing, reconciliations and general finance administration.

Experience within the automotive or manufacturing sector would be highly desirable. Candidates with previous experience of self-billing invoices will also be strongly considered.

Key Responsibilities
Processing purchase invoices and maintaining the Purchase Ledger
Processing sales invoices and maintaining the Sales Ledger
Matching invoices against purchase orders and supporting documentation
Processing and managing self-billing invoices
Completing supplier and customer account reconciliations
Investigating and resolving invoice and payment discrepancies
Supporting payment runs and ensuring invoices are processed accurately and on time
Responding to queries from suppliers, customers and internal departments
Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring information is kept up to date
Providing general support to the wider finance team as required
About You

We are looking for someone who:

Has previous experience in Purchase Ledger, Sales Ledger, Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable
Has good attention to detail and takes pride in maintaining accurate records
Is confident dealing with suppliers, customers and internal stakeholders
Has experience processing high volumes of invoices
Has a good understanding of reconciliations and resolving discrepancies
Is organised and able to manage their workload effectively
Has strong Excel and general IT skills
Automotive/manufacturing experience would be advantageous
Experience with self-billing invoices would be beneficial
The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is looking for a temporary position with a genuine opportunity to become permanent. The successful candidate will join a small, busy finance team and gain valuable experience within an established automotive/manufacturing business in Bartley Green
This is office working and hours are 8.30am-4.30pm with a finish at 3.30pm on a Friday

title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims on behalf of a number of Public Sector clients.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle a variety of casualty/personal injury claims through to settlement
- Verify policy cover/validity
- Log and record all claims digitally
- Investigate allocated claims either from desk or instructed by the team of loss adjusters
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Make decision on liability and negotiate settlement where appropriate
- Keep up to date with any technical changes within the industry and to your role which may involve participating in training programmes within the company

About you:
- Liability/Casualty Claims handling experience working in the Loss Adjusting, Insurance or Legal Sector
- Experience of handling your caseload of claims through to settlement
- The ability to value an injury loss
- Experience of handling defendant losses
- The ability or understand insurance policy wordings and the insurance market
- Knowledge of civil procedure rules and the claims portal
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Good planning and organisational skills
- Solid IT skills and be able to use multiple in-house systems
- Insurance Industry Qualifications or working towards desirable

Benefits on Offer:
- Remote or hybrid depending on location, 35 hours per week Monday to Friday
- Flexible benefits including holiday purchase plan and the opportunity to purchase health cash and BUPA dental plan, flexible working, 5% pension, life assurance 4 x, enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay, discounts with UK retailers, wellbeing hub and many more

title: Accounts Administrator & Cashier
description:
A national and well-established solicitors firm is seeking a motivated Accounts Administrator & Cashier to join its Finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional and organised individual looking to develop valuable experience within a supportive and collaborative environment. The role would suit someone with previous finance, accounts, or administration experience, as well as a strong junior candidate looking to gain practical experience within a professional finance environment. Full training will be provided while gaining exposure to a broad range of client account, cashiering, and financial administration duties.

As an Accounts Administrator & Cashier, you will support the day-to-day running of client accounts, with a particular focus on payments, reconciliations, compliance, and general finance administration. You will be responsible for checking completion statements, posting bills, posting monies received from clients, completing bank reconciliations, transferring monies between accounts, checking ledger statements, and completing compliance, money laundering, and fraud checks. As the role involves regular communication with solicitors and internal departments, you will need to be confident, professional, and well organised, with excellent communication skills and a strong attention to detail.

Ideally you will:
- Have previous experience within finance, accounts, administration, or a similar environment, although a strong junior candidate looking to gain finance experience will also be considered.
- Be highly numerate and accurate, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate financial records and processes.
- Demonstrate strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage your own workload, work well under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
- Have excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with solicitors, internal departments, and colleagues across the business.

In return, you will benefit from:
- Joining a well-established national solicitors firm with a strong reputation and working as part of a professional Finance team.
- Working within a supportive finance team where you will receive full training, guidance, and the opportunity to develop your skills.
- Gaining valuable practical experience across client accounts, cashiering, bank reconciliations, payments, compliance checks, and wider financial processes.
- A permanent, full-time position offering hybrid flexibility to give a great work-life balance.

If you are a professional, highly numerate, and organised individual looking to develop valuable experience within a professional Finance team, we would love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
Accounts Payable Administrator
Location: Solihull, West Midlands, B91 2 AA
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Pay Rate: £13.85 - £14.36 per hour
Contract: Full-Time, Temporary (3 Months)

We're looking for an Accounts Payable Administrator to join our busy Shared Services Finance team in Solihull on a temporary basis.
This is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable experience within a leading FMCG business, supporting a high-performing Accounts Payable function. You'll play a key role in ensuring supplier invoices are processed accurately, queries are resolved efficiently, and financial controls are maintained to the highest standards.

What You'll Be Doing
Invoice Processing
- Process supplier invoices accurately and within agreed service levels.
- Validate invoice details and ensure compliance with company policies.
- Monitor invoice workflow queues and resolve processing exceptions.
- Match invoices to purchase orders and goods receipts where applicable.

Supplier & Stakeholder Support
- Respond to supplier and internal customer queries via email and telephone.
- Manage shared Accounts Payable mailboxes, ensuring prompt responses.
- Investigate and resolve invoice, payment, and account discrepancies.
- Build and maintain positive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Reconciliations & Financial Controls
- Assist with supplier statement reconciliations.
- Support month-end processes and reporting activities.
- Maintain accurate financial records and audit trails.
- Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies, and audit requirements.

Administrative & Team Support
- Support data cleansing, reporting, and process improvement initiatives.
- Assist with Accounts Payable projects as required.
- Carry out general administrative tasks to support the wider finance team.

What We're Looking For
- Previous administrative experience, ideally within Finance or Accounts Payable.
- Excellent attention to detail with strong organisational skills.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and the wider Microsoft Office suite.
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
- Experience using SAP, Ariba, VIM, or other ERP systems would be beneficial.
- Understanding of Purchase-to-Pay (P2 P) processes and supplier management.

About You
We're looking for someone who is:
- Positive, professional, and proactive.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- A confident problem solver with a customer-focused approach.
- Adaptable and eager to learn new systems and processes.
- A supportive team player who enjoys working collaboratively.
- Committed to continuous improvement and delivering excellent service.

What's in It for You?
- Gain valuable experience with one of the UK's leading FMCG organisations.
- Develop your Accounts Payable and finance administration skills.
- Gain exposure to SAP and Shared Services operations.
- Work within a collaborative, supportive, and professional team.
- Enhance your experience in a fast-paced finance environment with opportunities to broaden your knowledge.

If you're looking to build on your finance administration experience and want to join a supportive team where your contribution will make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

title: Assistant Company Secretary
company: Jenkins Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Assistant Company Secretary
Location: Near Solihull (Hybrid)

Salary: £ plus bonus and excellent benefits

We're recruiting for an Assistant Company Secretary to join a successful financial services business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a long-term career in company secretarial practice within a supportive environment where no two days will be the same!

- Preparing Board and Committee agendas and meeting packs
- Attending meetings and producing high-quality minutes
- Drafting governance documentation and Board resolutions
- Managing statutory records and Companies House filings
- Supporting Annual Reports, Annual General Meetings and regulatory announcements
- Assisting with corporate governance and compliance requirements
- Supporting share schemes, corporate projects and restructures
- Building strong relationships with Directors, senior stakeholders and external advisers

About you
You'll ideally be:
- CGI qualified, studying towards qualification, or committed to becoming qualified
- Experienced in UK company secretarial practice with knowledge of the Companies Act 2006
- Confident preparing Board papers and taking Board minutes
- Highly organised, proactive and detail-focused
- An excellent communicator with strong written English
- Comfortable working with senior stakeholders

Experience within a listed company, financial services or another regulated environment would be advantageous.

- Excellent benefits package
- Broad exposure across listed and regulated businesses
- Friendly, collaborative working environment with scope for future growth

Applicants must already have the unrestricted right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, sponsorship is not available for this role.

title: Learning & Development Coordinator
description:
Learning & Development Coordinator

Salary - Dependent on Experience

Solihull

Full-Time

Permanent

We are looking for a Learning & Development Coordinator to design, coordinate, deliver and evaluate learning and development initiatives that enhance employee skills, knowledge, and performance, supporting both individual career development and organisational success. To manage the provision of mandatory training to ensure that the business remains compliant to required legislation.

The key duties and responsibilities are:

Training Delivery and Coordination
- Create, design, and deliver training and development courses/initiatives aligned to business needs
- Work closely and regularly with key internal stakeholders to shape development requirements
- Proactively engage with external providers to source training provision, where required
- Continually review training materials and ensure their suitability, compliance, and relevance
- Collaboratively manage early career offerings, ensuring their suitability, compliance, and content
- Monitor development KPI's, recording monthly and offering insight
- Using our Learning platform to create an intuitive end to end Learning Management System
- Occasional travel to other sites which may require the need for an overnight stay.

Learners
- Be accessible to all staff on site for structured and ad-hoc meetings regarding training
- Provide face to face support and coaching to learners and key stakeholders
- Monitor learners regularly through reporting, coaching and structured meetings
- Be visible within the business and engage with all departments regularly
- Work collaboratively and professionally with line managers regarding their learners.

Training Administration
- Ensure all training is delivered on time in line with required new starter requirements, mandatory renewals and bookings
- Managing our Apprenticeship scheme administration via the Gov website (Apprenticeship Service Account)
- Ensure all certification is produced, sent, and stored as required
- Manage training email inboxes to ensure they are up to date and actioned daily
- Accurately maintain and update internal and external portals and databases
- Collate and act upon course feedback
- Process purchase order numbers and invoices
- Ensure NDA (National Drainage Academy) database is fully updated
- Respond to customer enquiries via email, phone and in person
- Process training course bookings through internal systems
- Efficiently coordinate training providers to deliver required training in acceptable timescale
- Liaise with training providers and venues to confirm and cancel events
- Organise delegate accommodation where required, produce course literature, joining Instructions and invoices accordingly
- Organising training materials and printing in-house, when necessary, prior to the course
- Produce and send certification to delegates internally and externally, ensuring it is stored as required.

Management of Training
- Work within the training budget set, with any additional spend requested prior
- Communicate to the wider business on matters of learning and development
- Work within Human Resources, maintaining appropriate professional boundaries, confidentiality and impartiality when supporting learners, managers and colleagues
- Contribute to the development and delivery of a three-year strategic training and development plan, aligned with Human Resources priorities and wider business objectives
- Update the control tower monthly (metrics capture) to maintain accurate, current data and enable effective collaboration, reporting and decision-making across Human Resources and relevant stakeholders

This job description is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities to be undertaken by the Training & Development Officer, and you may be required to carry out other duties, which are felt to be reasonable and commensurate with the role.

The Skills, Qualifications and Experience required are:
- Demonstrable L& D experience, ideally within a compliance environment
- Experience coordinating and administering training & development programmes
- Experience managing an LMS
- Experience in designing learning interventions
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work on your own initiative
- Be an effective team player and actively contribute to our continual improvement culture
- Self- motivated with a positive can-do attitude
- Strong administrative skills with a good eye for detail and accuracy
- Comfortable with change and a continuous improvement environment
- A natural people person.
